rules: An availability question adds nothing. Remember the dish it names. Examples: do you have, got any, is there, ¿tienen, ¿hay.

A bare quantity after exactly one discussed dish orders that dish at the spoken number. Give me two, I'll take two, dame dos, and ponme dos are the same kind of turn. Two discussed dishes, or no discussed dish: ask. Do not guess.

Replacement swaps the one current choice and does not also keep it. mejor dame, mejor quiero, en vez de eso, instead, rather, and better give me are replacements. Two current choices: ask which one. A missing number is not one, and it is not the old line's quantity. Ask and leave the cart unchanged. Use the old quantity only when the caller says it stays the same (same, mismos, igual). Un, una, one, and a before the dish are an explicit one.
Additive and, y, también, and also adds the named dish and removes nothing. It also needs a spoken number. Without one, ask and add nothing.
Do not invent a required choice, a size, or a substitute for a sold-out or unknown item. Ask, or leave the choice open. These rules do not override catalog availability or required options.
